warnings: *** THE FIXTURE KEY FLAGGED AS MISSING ON A-11 AND A-12 IS ON THIS SHEET, AND EVERY FLAGGED NUMBER NOW RESOLVES. *** A-11 and A-12 tag fittings with circled digits 1-10 and carry no legend; both files recorded the unidentifiable ones by number with fixture_type_not_resolved rather than guessing from the icon. A-13 prints รายละเอียดสุขภัณฑ์ห้องน้ำ, a ten-row table giving all ten. Those two files have been rewritten with the resolved names and their flags cleared; the table itself is recorded once, on this sheet's own schedule file, and not duplicated into them.

*** THIS ALSO SETTLES A CALLOUT THAT COULD HAVE BEEN GUESSED WRONG: item 3 in the table is โถปัสสาวะชาย (a urinal), which appears in NO bathroom plan in this set. The table is a series-wide standard list, not a per-house take-off - so the presence of a row does not mean the fixture is installed. Only the numbers actually tagged on a plan are recorded as elements.
ห้องน้ำ 3 IS THE ONLY GROUND-FLOOR BATHROOM, at +0.50, matching A-03, A-04 and A-08's รูปตัด ก. Its 1.90 x 2.10 m is the largest of the three.
The room sits against grid ค and grid 4 per the bubbles on the plan, matching where A-04 puts ห้องน้ำ 3.
This file is one of four views on หน้า14 per §3; the others are รูปตัดขยายห้องน้ำ ค, the fixture schedule and the installation-height table.
